title: When pivot extraction fails
statement: Let $\nu$ be a finite set, choose a variable $v\in\nu$, and let a list of linear equations over $\mathbb F_2$ assign a coefficient to each variable. Pivot extraction at $v$ returns no equation if and only if every equation in the list has coefficient $0$ at $v$.
hypotheses_covered: $\nu$ is a finite type with decidable equality
The input is a list of linear equations over $\mathbb F_2$
